serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Here’s the money. You: Now, if that’s all… Landlord: Woah, woah! You are going already? You: Yes? Landlord: Come on now. There was a violent riot recently, remember? You need to sign the damage report. You: Damage report? Landlord: It’s just a bunch of bureaucratic bullshit, you don’t need to read it. I don’t want you to read it. Just sign it quickly and give it back. You: Sure… Let’s take a look anyway. It would be dumb of me to sign something that the landlord gave me without reading it first. The paper says that a violent group of people did graffiti all over the complex and pissed on my door, damaging it beyond repair… Landlord: {{punch}}Who allowed you to read it?! Landlord: Listen bud, you better quietly sign it like the rest. I already spent the emergency grant money that the city council gave me and if they reject my damage report because of you I will come back knocking on your door with a crowbar! You: Fine, I will sign it… Landlord: Atta boy! Landlord: See you in a week, hehehe~
